title: 📱 Xiaomi 18 Pro Finally Arrives Worldwide!
body: Xiaomi launched the 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max globally — the first phones with a rear display to arrive outside China in five years.
The small rear display shows notifications and works as a mirror for taking selfies with the rear cameras, while the cameras are 200 megapixels for the main and telephoto lenses, with Leica optics.
The phone runs on the new Snapdragon chip built on 2-nanometer technology, with a 6000 mAh battery, and its price in Europe starts at 1399 euros.
Do you like the idea of a rear display? Or do you see it as unnecessary?
